checks.operator_asks_bus_evidence_backfill_only: CHECK (((delivered_source IS DISTINCT FROM 'bus-report'::text) OR delivered_backfilled))
checks.operator_asks_committed_date_needs_outbo: CHECK (((committed_date IS NULL) OR (outbound_msg_id IS NOT NULL)))
checks.operator_asks_delivered_evidence_chk: CHECK (((delivered_source IS NULL) OR (delivered_source = 'manual'::text) OR (delivered_evidence_ref IS NOT NULL)))
checks.operator_asks_delivered_needs_source_chk: CHECK (((delivered_at IS NULL) OR (delivered_source IS NOT NULL)))

operator_asks_delivery_provenance_trg.def: CREATE TRIGGER operator_asks_delivery_provenance_trg BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF delivered_at, delivered_source ON public.operator_asks FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION operator_asks_delivery_provenance()

work_item_mirror_ask_trg.def: CREATE TRIGGER work_item_mirror_ask_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.operator_asks FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION work_item_mirror_ask_trg()
work_item_mirror_ask_trg.function_def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.work_item_mirror_ask_trg()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- The mirror must NEVER be able to block the system of record (orch-console review,
    -- bus #73195): an exception in here degrades to "work_item missing/stale for this one
    -- row, surfaced loudly", never an aborted operator_asks write. The 2026-10-24
    -- equivalence proof is the drift backstop that catches anything skipped this way.
    BEGIN
        PERFORM work_item_mirror('ask', 'operator_asks', NEW.id,
            work_item_derive_ask(NEW.id, NEW.ask, NEW.triage_state, NEW.closed_at,
                                  NEW.delegated_to, NEW.committed_date, NEW.triaged_by),
            'trigger:operator_asks');
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RAISE WARNING 'work_item mirror failed for operator_asks id=%: %', NEW.id, SQLERRM;
    END;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
